name: @pipeworx/mcp-clinicaltrials
description: Search and analyze ClinicalTrials.gov: trials by keyword/condition/drug/status/phase, one study's full design and results, counts by condition, trials by location, and recently updated trials, plus a sponsor-analytics suite (a sponsor's trials, pipeline, and activity, and head-to-head sponsor comparison), catalyst calendars, competitive-landscape summaries, enrollment-watch, results summaries, and phase-transition rates.
